newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Transaero launches Thai, Bali charter flights.
newsitem.headline: Transaero launches Thai, Bali charter flights.

text.p: Private Russian carrier Transaero will begin scheduled charter flights from Moscow to Phuket in Thailand and Bali in Indonesia from December 5, a company spokesman said on Monday.
Leonid Kligerman told Reuters that Transaero and Russian tourist company Svetal had signed agreement to carry tourists to these South East Asian resorts.

"We will operate a 290-seat DC-10 jet on the 10-hour non-stop flights from Moscow to Phuket and Bali," Kligerman said, adding that Transaero also hoped that tourists from Europe would use the new route.
Last week Transaero president Alexander Pleshakov said that the company would offer three classes of service on these flights, instead of the traditional economy class on charter route.
